CDS 프리미엄 상승은 곧 기업의 채무불이행 위험이 커진다는 의미다. 머스크는 자신이 이끄는 스페이스X에 대해선 “GPU 매입에 쓸 자금 400억달러를 확보했다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “스페이스X의 회사채는 투자등급이고, 저궤도 통신위성 인터넷 ‘스타링크’와 발사 사업의 매출도 양호하다”고 강조했다. 하지만 스페이스X는 이에 대해 공식적으로 발표하지 않았다. 특히 이 400억달러의 출처와 조달 조건 등을 구체적으로 공개하지 않았다. 머스크의 발언은 이번 주 애플과 마이크로소프트(MS), 아마존 등 미국 빅테크들이 7~9월 실적 발표를 앞두고 나왔다는 점이 주목된다. 사실상 스페이스X도 자금난에서 자유롭지 못하다는 점을 우회적으로 밝힌 셈이기 때문이다. 블룸버그통신과 CNBC 등 외신들은 “이번 기술주들의 실적은 AI 모델과 인프라 등 자본지출이 실제 수익성과 어떻게 연결되고 있는지 보여주는 최대 지표”라고 지적했다. 이미아 기자 mia@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 이미아 기자 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 AI 투자 불안에 국채 급등…메타 증자·스페이스X 통신 진출 주목[박신영의 개장전 요것만] 1. Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
items.d: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.
items.fullText: Security Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis The vulnerabilities are devastating in theory. But experts say they are also technically very difficult to hack. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 After researchers quietly found two devastating software vulnerabilities in August, they worked across borders and disciplines to develop patches that were released to the world Wednesday morning. Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 22, 2026, 6:07 PM EDT By Kevin Collier One day after governments around the world warned that newly publicized software vulnerabilities were so severe that websites should consider going offline until they could fix them, experts and insiders said there are few, if any, reports of widespread damage. That could still change, of course, and cybersecurity experts warn that the threat will remain for weeks, if not longer. Still, there were early signs Thursday that hackers were finding it difficult to capitalize on the vulnerabilities. “Across all our telemetry, and we are looking hard, we have only seen a couple of real exploitation attempts,” said Don Smith, vice president of threat research at the British software security firm Sophos. Experts agree that that was in part because of a behind-the-scenes, global effort that identified the flaw and quietly designed a fix to address it. The effort was aided, inadvertently, by the current limits of some widely available AI models, which did not appear to be very helpful at exploiting the vulnerabilities. And perhaps, they said, a little bit of luck. “My sense is that these [vulnerabilities] are harder to exploit than folks thought at first, so this could be a slow burn,” Smith said. The flaws were in PHP, a website programming language that is used in an estimated 69% of all websites. The campaign also gets an enhanced look: GeForce RTX 5080-class performance arrives for Ultimate members, bringing support for ray-tracing features in the cloud. There’s a new way to join the cloud, too: Existing supported Fire TV Stick users can now purchase one-month Performance or Ultimate memberships directly through Amazon, making it easier to sign up and start streaming on the big screen. Plus, Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE brings cinematic pixel art and strategic battles to the cloud, and The Elder Scrolls Online’s Echoes of Skyrim Season adds the entire Greymoor Chapter free for all ESO Standard Edition owners. It’s all part of six games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Deployment Without the Downloads Squad up and answer the call on the cloud. Activision and Infinity Ward’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches today on GeForce NOW. Members can drop into the trenches in Korea, close-quarter combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, night raids in Mumbai and city-wide engagements to reclaim occupied territory. Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad as a routine patrol turns into a desperate fight for survival. items.fullText: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure. October 21, 2026 by Uttara Kumar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence , a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. items.fullText: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents Growing ecosystem of AI clouds across Europe, Nordics, Africa and Central Asia build full-stack NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factories as AI-native companies drive demand for sovereign compute, training, inference and post-training services. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements.
